Eastern Ridge trail guide

Updated weekly · 12 routes

Day walks

EASY

Millpond circuit

A flat, family-friendly loop around the old millpond, with benches at every bend and a short boardwalk through the reeds. Surfaces are firm in all weather.

Distance 3.2 kmTime 45 minAscent 20 m

MODERATE

Birch Hollow and the long ridge

Climbs steadily through birch woodland, emerges onto open moor and follows the ridge for two kilometres before dropping back by a stream. Take water; there is none on the tops. CairnsSmall piles of stones marking the route when mist comes down. mark the path where it fades.

Distance 11.5 kmTime 4 hAscent 480 m

Mountain routes

HARD

The Saddle traverse (new)

A committing day over two summits and the exposed saddle between them. Navigation skills and good weather are needed; turn back at the notch if cloud is below the second summit. Winter conditions are common from November.

Distance 18 kmTime 7–8 hAscent 1,150 m

A
B
EASY

Quarry steps

One hundred and forty stone steps built by the quarrymen, rising to a viewpoint above the village. Short, steep, and rewarding. Handrail on the upper half.

Distance 1.1 kmTime 25 minAscent 90 m

MODERATE

Heron Beck gorge

Follows the beck upstream through a narrow wooded gorge, with several stream crossings on stepping stones. After rain the stones are underwater and the route should not be attempted.

Distance 7 kmTime 3 hAscent 210 m

Check the weather forecast before setting out.
